task: Estimate the federal income tax I would owe on $158,500 of taxable income in ZIP code 97007, filing as single.
agent_final_answer:
Using SmartAsset's Federal Income Tax Calculator (2025 estimate), the federal income tax owed on $158,500 of taxable income, filing as single in ZIP code 97007, is approximately $30,887. The marginal tax rate is 24% and the effective federal rate is about 19.5%.

Note: SmartAsset's calculator takes gross "Household Income" and subtracts the standard deduction to derive taxable income. To make taxable income equal exactly $158,500, household income was set to $174,250 (= $158,500 + the $15,750 single standard deduction) with location Beaverton, OR (ZIP 97007). For reference, if $158,500 were instead entered directly as household income (i.e., gross income), the federal tax would be $27,107.
